datasets.title: American Samoa: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in American Samoa: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/american-samoa-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were created by applying machine learning algorithms to commercially available satellite imagery to identify building footprints, then overlaying population estimates derived from census data and demographic statistics in partnership with Columbia University. The resulting gridded datasets provide spatial distribution of total population and demographic subgroups at fine resolution across American Samoa.

sources.name: Facebook/Meta AI and Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning model applied to satellite imagery to identify building footprints and locations for population allocation

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology based on publicly available census data and demographic statistics overlaid on building locations
